pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)The Annihilation Plane breaks blocks and picks up items. It works similarly to an $(l:items_blocks_machines/import_bus)ME Import Bus$(/l), pushing things into $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l). For items to be picked up, they must collide with the face of the plane, it does not pick up in an area.$(br2)Annihilation planes can be enchanted with any pickaxe

enchantment, so yes, you can put crazy levels of fortune on a few and $(l:example_setups/ore_fortuner)automate ore processing$(/l) if your modpack allows it. In addition, silk touch does what you'd expect it to, efficiency reduces the energy cost of breaking a block, and unbreaking gives a chance of not using any energy.$(br2)They are $(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)cable subparts$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)REMEMBER TO ENABLE FAKE PLAYERS IN YOUR CHUNK$()

pages.title: Filtering
pages.text: The annihilation plane will only break a block or pick up an item if it can store the resulting drops/items in its network. This means to filter one, $(o)you must restrict what can be stored on its network$(), most likely by putting it on a $(l:ae2_mechanics/subnetworks)subnetwork$(/l). A $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l) or $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)cell$(/l) can be $(l:items_blocks_machines/cell_workbench)partitioned$(/l) to achieve this.$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()

Again, it filters $(o)by the item drops$() so, for example, if you want to filter breaking of $(item)Amethyst Cluster$()s, you need a plane enchanted with silk touch, otherwise every previous growth stage drops nothing and so the plane will break them no matter what, as the network can always store "nothing".
